extracted.name: Scrambled Peanut Butter Eggs
extracted.description: Peanut butter adds creamy richness to these scrambled eggs seasoned with ginger and garlic that are a savory, filling breakfast for 2.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon sriracha sauce, or to taste
instruction_lines: Whisk eggs, peanut butter, ginger, garlic, seasoning sauce, and sriracha sauce together in a small bowl.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Pour in egg mixture; cook and stir until scrambled and firm, about 5 minutes.
